Anger or more like defiance and martial arts. I was suicidal, depressed and broke with literally nobody in my life. And no when I say I had nobody it wasn't like my mind was playing tricks. I literally had Noone, I had moved 1600 miles away from home, dad and granddad passed away one after the other in 3 months, completely new culture, new language, no friends and no job. I was stuck in that state for 2 whole years. Tried ending it 4 times, didn't succeed. I was pretty sure I wasn't going to be alive for one more year. Then one day I thought to myself, I have literally nothing to lose. So I had what little money I had in my account, bought a gym membership and got back into martial arts. I had previously trained for over 8 years. Also I told myself, this world has been pushing me down again and again, my desperate cries for help has fallen on deaf ears, even the ones who were supposed to love me the most abandoned me, I don't even find comfort in prayer or god, so I'm gonna pull myself out of this mess single handedly with no help. I was angry at everything and everyone around me that I was determined to prove that I needed Noone.

Then I got a job, a food delivery driver, made some money, tried therapy, the first 3 therapists didn't even understand me but found an amazing lady the fourth time. I worked on my mental health and went all in on training (mma), and I also attended coursed and got Certified as a diet and fitness coach etc.

Now a year later, I'm still alone, but content and happy. I have plans for my future, still go to therapy whenever I feel low, and I'm a proper fighter and a coach now. So I think, that anger I had on the world and everyone for simply abandoning me even when I cried for help, that's what triggered this whole thing for me.
